concept: Track Diagram Relit, with the original tube's light brought back on the short list of live things and nowhere else. The diagram is unchanged: steel lines on green-black slate boards, a lamp at every stop, times in a timetable margin, matte plates for what the family keeps. What changes is the light where attention belongs. The mark and its cursor, 'mind', the one primary key, Home's box, the live lamps and the occupied run of track each glow in the tube's two-layer halo (a tight bloom inside a wide faint one), clearly visible at 100%. The machine's own surfaces (the greeting's glass, the cases, the keys, her bubbles, the lit screens) catch a highlight along their top edges. The page itself keeps only the original's faint breath of afterglow under the bar, gone before the page title, so the page stays calm.
companions: Unchanged from the parent: steel-cyan #a7c4d8 is the family's hand (links, 'here', rings, tab caps, the month's today); the trays and plates are green-black slate (#0f1519 tray, #161c20 plate); headings are cream #ebe6da; the section and kind colours stay in their lamps and tints; the greeting's corner keeps its cobalt wash (#4f66e0 at 2.4); each page's terminus ring is a small lit screen in that page's colour. The green spreads to none of these, and the bar is the parent's slate again. The one colour change: 'Finish setting up', 'Something to eat' and the trouble panel now sit on the same slate tray as every other board, with amber kept to their edge and rings.
decisions: Parent kept whole: tokens, glow numbers (glow, screenGlow and topGlow 1.0, washGlow 2.4), type, lines and layout are Track Diagram Relit's. relight.css is appended after the parent's css, and the lit-track section of phosphor.css is rewritten; the css is 56,602 of 60,000 characters. The markup gains one empty decorative span (.now-run, aria-hidden) in three places, no words.

The lit track is a second element laid over the steel. Every rail stays steel; where a section is occupied, a run of #6dff9c with a 1px white-hot core (var(--hot)) holds for 65% of the way and then fades to transparent, so the steel shows through before the next stop. Its bloom is drop-shadow(0 0 2px brand) drop-shadow(0 0 8px brand/45%), which follows the run's own alpha and so falls off with the light instead of glowing along the steel. Home's Coming up draws the steel on the board under the run; To do and Plans carry the run in a .now-run span; Status's live chain uses the free li::before. On Home the run now samples (109,255,155) where the parent's read (95,208,137), with 3px above it (30,62,46) against (14,22,25). This also fixes a parent bug: its --track-lit was resolved at :root, so the 90deg direction set on Home's horizontal run never applied, and the 2px line was shaded across its thickness.

Lamps use E20's numbers: 0 0 4px brand, 0 0 10px brand/65%, 0 0 18px 1px brand/48%, so the halo reads 12-14px out (Home's now lamp: (27,56,42), (21,39,34), (18,32,30) at 9, 12, 14px against the parent's (22,42,36), (18,31,30), (16,27,28)). The -1.4s phase is gone. A live lamp breathes outward: core and tight bloom hold and the wide halo swells from 48% to 56% (22px, 2px spread) and back, so its weakest moment is E20's full strength.

The page's afterglow is the original's breath, not a band: one radial of #6dff9c (10.5% in 60% by 135px, fading out by 85%), no raster. 8px under the bar it samples (15,24,18), as the original's (14,23,18), and it is back to the ground (11,14,12) by the page title. The scanlines are off the page ground; they stay where the phosphor is (tubes, her screens, the greeting's glow, the terminus tiles).
The bar is the parent's again (#0f1519 at 88%, centre (14,21,24)): the mark's halo is the one light in it, as in the original.

The tube's two-layer halo on every lit word and mark: the mark's tile (inset rim, 8px bloom, 30px halo) and its icon's two drop-shadows; the three-layer cursor; 'mind' at 2px, 0.4em and 1.2em; Send at a 50% ring, a 12px tight bloom and E3's pool (0 8px 28px -10px brand/70%), under a 25% white top edge (30% on hover) so it reads as a key lit from inside, not a glossy pill. Home's box glows at rest (20px and 50px blooms) as the original's did, and every box lights in sage var(--lit) in three layers while typed in.

Highlights along the top edges of the machine's surfaces only (E8): the case at 17% white with a soft second line and a 90px spill; her bubbles a 20% screen rim; the terminus screens and her tiles a 30-34% rim of their own colour; the greeting's glass a 1px phosphor rim at 30% over a 26px falloff (12px on the phone, clear of the speaker row). The family's plates keep the parent's 3.5%.
Chat's box is the parent's plate at rest and lights only when written in; the lit ring at the end of the line says whose turn it is.

The kit's access behaviour is kept: more contrast drops the glass rim and the halos of the mark, the key word, the tiles, a ticked box, a done task and Home's resting box (the box still lights fully when typed in); forced colours draw the now lamp and its run in CanvasText and hide the rim; reduced motion stops the breath and the cursor.
strengths: The light is back where attention belongs and only there: the mark, 'mind', Send, Home's box, the live lamps, the lit runs, the tubes and her screens glow in the tube's layered halo at 100%, while slate, steel, plates, headings and section colours stay exactly the parent's.

The lit track, the parent's best idea, now reads as lit on Home, To do, Plans and Status: a white-hot core held for most of the run, a bloom that falls off with it, and the steel rail showing through as the light fades toward the next stop.
The page is calmer than the first draft and no hazier than the original: no scanlined band behind any title, the bar back to slate, one breath under the bar that is gone before the title.
The setup and restaurant boards lose their olive-grey fill (19,22,18) and sit on the same slate as every board, amber kept to the edge and rings, so warm fill no longer sits beside the green.
Measures are clean: signature exact, ink 12.75:1, smallest text 11.52px, no sideways scroll, one target under 44px, the page's words unchanged.
weaknesses: It is still a phosphor mutant: at half size beside the parent the change is in small lit things (the mark, 'mind', Send, lamps, runs, the greeting's rim, the slate setup board). A judge looking for a new structure will find none, by design.

The page's afterglow is now nearly invisible (about 4 levels over the ground just under the bar). That is the original's strength, but the 'afterglow at the top of every page' no longer registers as a feature.

The lamp's breath swells outward, so a still taken near mid-cycle (as the harness's 1.8s is) catches the swell at 56% rather than the resting 48%. It is never below E20's strength, but the camera sees its brighter phase.
The month view's today lamp is an 8px dot beside words, so its halo is only a few levels brighter than the parent's; the month has no run of track to carry the light.
Send's near edge is brighter than the original's (50% ring and a 12px tight bloom: 2px under Send (50,111,72) against the original's (37,82,53)); the pool itself now matches the original.
Three empty decorative spans (.now-run) were added to carry the lit runs over the steel; the rule the page uses to draw a line is now two elements where the run is lit.
revisions: Page afterglow: scanlines removed from the page ground (body::before gone) and the two radials replaced by one breath, 10.5% in a 60% by 135px ellipse. I used 135px and 10.5% rather than the note's 100px and 8%, because by my arithmetic the note's numbers give only about (12,17,14) 8px under the bar, not the (16,26,20) it aimed for. Measured now: (15,24,18) 8px under the bar, back to the ground (11,14,12) before the title. On chat-phone, the ground beside 'Vera' reads (11,14,12) with no stripes, where the first draft sampled (21,39,27) and (25,51,33).
Bar: its own radial glow and 80% glass removed; back to the parent's #0f1519 at 88% (centre (14,21,24)).

Lamps: E20's numbers (4px, 10px 65%, 18px 1px 48%); the -1.4s phase dropped. Partly declined: rather than breathe the wide layer down to 30% (which is exactly where a 1.8s still catches it), the halo breathes outward from 48% to 56% and back, so the lamp is never below E20's strength at any phase.

Lit track: rebuilt as a separate lit run over the steel (Home board background, a .now-run span on To do and Plans, li::before on Status): #6dff9c with a 1px var(--hot) core held for 65%, fading to transparent over the steel, bloomed with drop-shadow(0 0 2px) drop-shadow(0 0 8px 45%). Also fixed the parent's :root-resolved gradient direction on Home's horizontal run.
Chat: removed the composer's resting phosphor edge and glow; it keeps the parent's plate edge and lights on focus only.

Send and 'Add it': the pool is E3's 0 8px 28px -10px brand/70% (was 0 14px 42px -6px 52%); 50% ring and 12px tight bloom kept; white top edge 0.42 to 0.25 (hover 0.3); hover pool E3's 0 10px 34px -10px 85%.
Greeting catch-light: rim 55% to 30% (samples (61,117,78), was (79,167,107)), falloff tint 9% to 8%; under 40rem the band is 12px, clear of the speaker row.
'Finish setting up', 'Something to eat' and the trouble panel: fill #131612 to var(--tray), amber kept on the #644e29 edge and the rings.
Not taken up: typographic changes. This is the round's phosphor mutant (the parent with the original light and nothing else changed), so the type stays the parent's for a clean comparison.
